# Review, pass 1 — kebra-nagast-ch95 (ch. 95)

Edits made by script. Units are numbered from 0.

Totals: 0 major, 11 moderate, 29 minor; 7 findings refused.

## Refused findings

1. Unit 0, ኀብሩ / ክብሩ: whether the title means 'they gathered', 'his union' or something else cannot be settled without Dillmann and the context; the three fields are hedged (?) and the number clash is now said. Left.
2. Unit 3, ለቢሶ and unit 2, ተሰዊሮ called 'converb': the project's own earlier reviews accept the word for the -o gerund with a ወ- or alone; the parse is right. Left.
3. Unit 9, ንሄሉ `l` 'we-shall-be' against `i` 'shall sit upon our throne': a contextual rendering of ሀለወ with ዲበ መንበርነ; the note gives 'be/dwell'. Left.
4. Unit 17, ክራማት `l`/`i` 'cold seasons (?)' against the note 'winters': already hedged in all three fields, and no better reading can be had without Dillmann. Left.
5. Unit 25, 'is rendered' for ኢኮነት ድሉተ against Genesis 1:2 and ይጼልል 'hovers': a fair description of the Geʿez paraphrase, and the note already says the present tense is a story present. Left.
6. Unit 15, the Paul attribution: the note already says it is probably an echo, not a quotation, of Romans/Galatians (?). Left.
7. Unit 7, 'This unit is long (38 words)': count agrees with the packet (no ። ፤ ፨ inside). Left.

## Glossary

No `gloss.json` yet; this was pass 1 on `units.json` only. For the glosser and pass 2: ባሕርይ is "pearl" (house; "nature" only as the other possibility); ወይኴንን is ኰነነ "judge"; ሰገዲ is the verb ሰገደ "bowed down" (spelled for ሰገዱ); ይቤዝዎ is 3ms; ረሰያ is "he made her"; ለምሥሃል "mercy", sense uncertain; ሀቡ is the hortative "come!"; ዘንዜንዎሙ is from ዜነወ; ኦሪት is not Greek; ጥቀ is "very, exceedingly"; ዐላዊያን is "wrongdoing ones"; ተሠረዉ (unit 10) is the passive of ሠረወ; መሀይምን is unclear (?).
